senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. טוּשׁ I)to polish, sharpen.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 95b">Snh. 95ᵇ</cite> (<cite ref="K00703"><he>כלום</he></cite>) <he>מגלך נְטוּשָׁה</he> is thy sickle (of death) polished? <cite ref="Shabbat 67a:7">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> (in an incantation) <he>חרב שלופה וקלע נטושח</he> the sword is drawn and (the stones of) the sling sharpened.
